interpretation.layout_signature: Ordered Room N signature when full parent-index coverage is available.
interpretation.layout_multiset_signature: Stable room-assembly signature independent of threaded stream order and available for legacy captures.
interpretation.reward_seed: Still a correlation candidate; equality with layout seed is not assumed.
interpretation.dungeon_root_seed: Primary cTkResourceDescriptor seed attached to MODELS/SPACE/POI/DUNGEON.SCENE.MBIN; strongest current layout-seed candidate but still unverified.
interpretation.resource_seed_lineage: Ordered non-zero descriptor seeds on DUNGEON resource add/find events; used to locate the derivation chain without assuming any event is RNG state.
